verdict.rationale: Pylon documents official mobile SDKs for iOS, Android and React Native, plus a JavaScript API for the chat widget, so first-party SDKs do exist. They are scoped to embedding and customizing the chat widget, not to building against Pylon's data or agent platform. The REST API, webhooks and MCP server are separate interfaces, not SDKs, and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: general-purpose official API client SDKs (e.g. Python/TypeScript) for issues, accounts and agents; a published OpenAPI spec for SDK generation (probe found none); independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Pylon's mobile SDKs allow you to embed the chat widget directly in your mobile app, providing users with in-app support without leaving your application.
Embed Pylon's chat widget in your iOS, Android, or React Native application.
JavaScript API to build workflows and customize behavior in code
